scope: Actual SDK with deterministic loopback provider replies, macOS investigation launcher without outer filesystem isolation. No external model calls.
finding: The original three-call grant is exhausted by two root requests plus one child request. With no follow-up, the completion wakeup causes no additional provider request. After an independent eight-call follow-up acknowledgement, the original child completes normally, but its root wakeup takes a second request from the new grant and is labelled with the new turn ID.
distinction: Selective timeout cancellation is fixed by this iteration; shared-root completion wakeup causal ownership remains unfixed. This probe contains no file-writing tool and lets the original child finish in its already-reserved third call.
next_work: Bind wakeup admission to canonical SDK message source and original task, covering queued notices and mixed active-root steering without borrowing another grant.
replay: Copy the three mjs files together to a fresh directory two levels below the repository root; run probe.mjs and probe.mjs --followup. The original task has three calls; the independent follow-up has eight calls and 30 seconds.
